field.name: StateSync
field.summary: Stable synchronization gate for lifecycle state access and transitions.

field.name: state
field.summary: Backing field for the current lifecycle state.

field.name: startedadmitted
field.summary: Indicates whether the current Active lifecycle cycle has admitted its terminal Started callback.

field.name: stoppedadmitted
field.summary: Indicates whether the current InActive lifecycle cycle has admitted its terminal Stopped callback.

method.name: TrySetState
method.summary: Atomically validate and set a permitted lifecycle state.
method.param: The state before the entry attempt.
Whether the operation succeeds when the target state is already current.
method.returns: True when the target state is entered or already current when allowed.

method.name: SetState
method.summary: Atomically assign a permitted lifecycle state and reset terminal callback admission for a new lifecycle phase.
method.param: The state before the entry attempt.
Whether the operation succeeds when the target state is already current.
method.returns: True when the target lifecycle state is assigned.

method.name: TryAdmitOperation
method.summary: Atomically determine whether a lifecycle operation may proceed.
method.param: The state before the operation was evaluated.
method.returns: The result of the lifecycle operation admission.

method.name: TryInitialize
method.summary: Atomically enter or continue in the Initialized state when the lifecycle permits initialization.
method.param: The state before the entry attempt.
method.returns: True when the Initialized state is entered or is already current.

method.name: TryActivate
method.summary: Atomically enter the Active state when the lifecycle permits activation.
method.param: The state before the entry attempt.
method.returns: True when the Active state is entered.

method.name: CommandChangeOK
method.summary: Determine if OK to change commands.
method.returns: True if OK to change commands.

method.name: TryDeactivate
method.summary: Atomically enter the InActive state when the lifecycle permits deactivation.
method.param: The state before the entry attempt.
method.returns: True when the InActive state is entered.

method.name: HostedServicesChangeOK
method.summary: Determine if OK to change hosted services.
method.returns: True if OK to change hosted services.

method.name: InitializeOK
method.summary: Determine if OK to begin or continue Initialize.
method.returns: True if OK to begin Initialize.

method.name: ToError
method.returns: True if State changed to Error.
